content.text: In Zimbabwe, where payment restrictions and currency collapse crippled digital commerce, COREMERCH emerged as a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution, answering the question: How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe? By deploying Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s can bypass platform fees, ensure data ownership, and thrive in restricted markets. With a 0.5% fee on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|Crypto Payment]] payments via NOWPayments, the savings are substantial. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-deploying-digital-store-cloudflare|difference]] retains $921. This post breaks down the infrastructure components and explains how to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed for high-performance and low-latency file delivery. It's particularly suited for serving digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software. By storing digital products on Cloudflare R2, creators can ensure fast and reliable delivery to customers worldwide, without relying on traditional e-commerce platforms like Gumroad or Stripe. This approach not only saves on platform fees but also provides full control over data ownership and distribution.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments is built around a decentralized, blockchain-based payment processing system. When a customer purchases a digital product, the payment is verified on-chain, and a unique token is generated. This token is then used to retrieve the digital product from Cloudflare R2, ensuring secure and instant delivery. The NOWPayments fee of 0.5% is a fraction of the 10% charged by Gumroad, making it an attractive option for creators looking to maximize their earnings.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack is designed for creators in restricted markets, where traditional payment processing platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. By deploying Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, creators can establish a direct connection with their customers, bypassing platform fees and ensuring full control over their digital products. This approach is particularly beneficial for creators selling ebooks, courses, and software in countries like Zimbabwe, Ghana, or Kenya, where payment restrictions are common.
COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack can retain up to $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack include Cloudflare R2 for object storage, NOWPayments for decentralized payment processing, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. These components work together to provide a seamless and secure experience for customers, while ensuring data ownership and control for creators. By leveraging these technologies, creators can deploy a scalable and reliable digital commerce solution, tailored to their specific needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, follow these steps: Start by signing up for a Cloudflare account and setting up a new R2 bucket. Configure NOWPayments for decentralized payment processing and integrate it with your Cloudflare account. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to create a backend logic for handling payments and delivering digital products. Finally, upload your digital products to Cloudflare R2 and test the deployment to ensure seamless delivery and payment processing.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Q: How do I sell an ebook online without relying on traditional e-commerce platforms like Gumroad or Stripe? A: By deploying Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery, and using NOWPayments for decentralized payment processing, you can bypass platform fees, ensure data ownership, and thrive in restricted markets. With a 0.5% fee on crypto payments, the savings are substantial, retaining up to $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments provide a seamless and secure experience for customers, while ensuring data ownership and control for creators.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, follow these steps: Sign up for a Cloudflare account and set up a new R2 bucket; Configure NOWPayments for decentralized payment processing and integrate it with your Cloudflare account; Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to create a backend logic for handling payments and delivering digital products; Upload your digital products to Cloudflare R2 and test the deployment to ensure seamless delivery and payment processing.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Cloudflare R2 and traditional object storage services like Amazon S3?

Cloudflare R2 is designed for high-performance and low-latency file delivery, making it particularly suited for serving digital products. It's also more cost-effective and provides better control over data ownership and distribution.
How does NOWPayments handle payment processing and what is the fee structure?

NOWPayments uses a decentralized, blockchain-based payment processing system, processing payments for 300+ cryptocurrencies. The fee is 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than traditional e-commerce platforms like Gumroad, which charge 10% on every sale.
Can I use Cloudflare R2 for storing and delivering other types of files besides digital products?

Yes, Cloudflare R2 can store and deliver any type of file, including images, videos, and documents. However, its high-performance and low-latency features make it particularly suited for serving digital products, such as ebooks and software.
How do I integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script with Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments?

You can use APIs and SDKs provided by Cloudflare and NOWPayments to integrate your chosen backend logic with Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments. This will enable seamless payment processing and delivery of digital products.
What happens if I encounter issues with payment processing or digital product delivery?

Cloudflare's 24/7 support and NOWPayments' comprehensive documentation ensure that you can quickly resolve any issues that arise.
